strings.Рязанская земля; Ярославский, Кашинский,: The Ryazan land; Yaroslavl, Kashin, Uglich, Tver and Oryol uyezds; the Russian North and the Northern Dvina
strings.пожня Крестцы у реки Которосли, Ярославс: the Krestsy hayfield on the Kotorosl river, Yaroslavl uyezd
strings.участник суда ярославского тиуна: participant in the court of the Yaroslavl tiun
strings.Назван около 1495—1497 годов среди шести: Named around 1495–1497 among six people present at the court of the Yaroslavl tiun Afanasy Durov in a dispute over the Kresttsy hayfield by the river Kotorosl.
strings.Акт не называет Анфилофа истцом, ответчи: The act does not call Anfilof a plaintiff, defendant, judge or landowner: the formula «на суде были» ["at the court were"] proves presence but does not allow his social estate and function to be determined without reservation.
strings.Анфилоф — личное имя; Селиванов может бы: Anfilof is a personal name; Selivanov may be a patronymic or already a stable second naming. The source has no patronymic in the modern three-part form.
strings.Это самый ранний найденный человек, личн: This is the earliest person found who is personally named with a form of the name close to Onfilog, and therefore an important chronological parallel for the eponym of the village that existed by 1539/1540.
strings.Связь с тверским Онфилоговом, Никольским: A link with the Tver Onfilogovo, Nikolskoye Svechino, the Yurlovs or Tonkoi Onfilogov has not been established; his biography must not be transferred to Tver uyezd on the basis of the name alone.
strings.В конце правой грамоты стоит формула: «А: At the end of the judgment charter stands the formula: «А на суде были Гордин соцкой, да Григорей Ярцев, да Мита Галасьев, да Лука Максимов, да Клим Давыдов, да Анфилоф Селиванов» ["And present at the court were Gordin the sotsky, and Grigorei Yartsev, and Mita Galasyev, and Luka Maksimov, and Klim Davydov, and Anfilof Selivanov"]. Anfilof is named sixth and last in the list. This reading has been checked against the facsimile of printed pages 218–219, not taken only from the name index.
strings.Издатели датировали акт приблизительно 1: The editors dated the act to approximately 1495–1497 on the basis of its participants and procedural circumstances. Anfilof was an adult capable of attending an official land court, some 42–45 years before the first description of Onfilogovo in Tver. By generation he fits the time when the already established name of the village arose.
strings.Суд происходил в Ярославском уезде и кас: The court sat in Yaroslavl uyezd and concerned the Krestsy hayfield on the Kotorosl river, which was disputed with the Spaso-Yaroslavsky Monastery. The exact location of the hayfield has not been reconstructed; the map places a cautious marker at the monastery and does not present it as Anfilof's homestead or land.
strings.Что означает «на суде были»: What «на суде были» ["present at the court were"] means
strings.Формула перечисляет присутствующих при р: The formula lists the people present at the proceedings. The name index of the edition describes Anfilof as a «муж» ["man"] at the court of the Yaroslavl tiun — a participant in the judicial procedure, possibly a witness (poslukh) or an assessor from the local community. The text itself does not call him plaintiff, defendant, judge, scribe, or owner of the disputed hayfield.
strings.Можно ли назвать его крестьянином: Can he be called a peasant?
strings.Нет, пока нельзя. В отличие от Тонкого О: No, not yet. Unlike Tonkoi Onfilogov, whom the scribe placed in a list of monastery households, Anfilof Selivanov's social status is not given in this line. He could have belonged to local landholders, service people, or well-off peasants, but choosing one version over another without a further act would be invention.
strings.Анфилоф — личное мужское имя; Селиванов: Anfilof is a male personal name; Selivanov is a second name in -ov, most naturally linked to a father or senior person named Selivan. In the late 15th century this was not necessarily a hereditary surname of the modern type. The literal reading could have sounded like «Анфилоф, Селиванов [сын]» ["Anfilof, Selivan's [son]"].
strings.Почему форма Анфилоф важна для Онфилогов: Why the form Anfilof matters for Onfilogovo
strings.Она показывает живой вариант того же ред: It shows a living variant of the same rare name cluster: Anfilof — Onfilog — Anfilog. Shifts of initial A-/O-, wavering between final -f/-g, and the insertion of -l-/-log occur when scribes and everyday speech rendered an unfamiliar church name. The coincidence does not prove one and the same person, but it makes the reconstruction of the name from the toponym considerably more reliable.
strings.Анфилоф Селиванов назван лично и примерн: Anfilof Selivanov is named personally and about forty years earlier than Tonkoi; Tonkoi, however, gives the form Onfilogov, almost literally matching the stem of the toponym, and points to another Onfilog of the preceding generation. The first candidate is stronger as a direct bearer of the name in the right era, the second as an exact phonetic match. Both lack a personal link to Tver.
strings.Почему это не найденный основатель: Why this is not the founder found
strings.Документ связывает Анфилофа с судебным с: The document connects Anfilof with a court event on the Kotorosl in Yaroslavl uyezd, not with Nikolskoye Svechino, Khorvach volost, or Tver uyezd. The act contains no Onfilogovo, no Yurlovs, and no land transfer. Therefore the man cannot be moved 170–200 km and declared the eponym merely because of a rare name and a fitting date.
strings.Нужен второй акт, где Анфилоф Селиванов: A second act is needed in which Anfilof Selivanov or his children appear in Tver uyezd, alongside the Yurlovs, at Nikolskoye Svechino, or in a chain of land transfer. Documents revealing his patronymic, holdings, and kin would also be useful. For now his status is a confirmed bearer of the name and a candidate for further checking, but not the founder.

strings.До 1600 года имя Анфилоф/Анфилог, близки: Before 1600 the name Anfilof/Anfilog, the close forms Anfil/Onfil and derived patronymics are documented in at least seven regional settings. The northern series now includes the Anfilovskaya village of 1573 and the sheepskin-maker Anfilofy Novik Ivanov syn of 1575; the Vladimir muster roll (desyatnya) of 1596 shows on the primary scan the exact formula «Анфилов сын Вакина» ["Anfilov son of Vakin"]. This makes the model of several independent family formations more probable than the search for one common incoming founder, but the towns of origin of the seven Oryol lines have not yet been established.
strings.ИМЕНА И МЕХАНИЗМ. Реестр показывает две:
NAMES AND MECHANISM. The register shows two different stages. In the first, Anfilof, Anfilog or the close documentary forms Anfil and Onfil are the personal name of a specific man: Anfilof Selivanov, Anfilofy Ivanovich, Anfilof Moiseyevich, Anfilog Ivanovich Konstantinov, Onfilof Nesterov, Onfil Ivanov, Anfil Vakin of Vladimir and Anpilog Ivanovich Onanyin. In the second, the name becomes a dependent naming of another person: Antipa Anfilogov syn, Peshok Anfilofov syn, Tonkoi Onfilogov and Antip Anfilov syn Vakina. Hence the -ov form existed as a patronymic or family naming long before it can confidently be regarded as a hereditary surname.

THE 16TH-CENTURY INTERVAL. The Kurostrov scrolls give a dense cross-section: in 1549 Onfilof Nesterov pays together with his nephew, in the 1550s he is probably repeated as «Анфилофей Несте…» ["Anfilofey Neste…"], and in 1592 Onfil Ivanov is recorded separately. In 1596 the Vladimir muster roll adds the formula «Антип Анфилов сын Вакина» ["Antip Anfilov son of Vakin"], which on the primary scan clearly separates the patronymic Anfilov and the third naming Vakin. Nearby occur Petrok Anfilov and a long line of Anfal / Anfalov. They are kept for comparison but not mixed into the main series: A. F. Bek's reference book lists Anfalov from Aifal/Anfal separately from Anfilov from Amfilokhy or Anfim.

GEOGRAPHY. The bearers do not form a single linear path. They appear simultaneously in the Ryazan land, Yaroslavl, Kashin, Vladimir, the Russian North, the Northern Dvina and Uglich. This distribution is too wide for the assumption of one common recent ancestor. Ryazan stands out for the repetition of the name in different generations and for its proximity to the documented resettlement of servicemen to the new southern towns; the Kashin–Uglich circle for its proximity to the Tver Onfilogovo; Vladimir for a formula contemporary with Oryol but independent. None of them has yet been connected to Oryol by a personal move.

MEANING FOR THE ORYOL CORE. In Oryol in 1594/95 there already existed at least seven fathers of surname bearers: Mikula, Vasily, Persha, Timofey, Nechay, Pakhom and Terenty. At the same time, in another Oryol nest, a pomeshchik with the personal name Anpilog Onanyin is known. The most economical new model is not to look for one ready-made family that suddenly arrived in Oryol, but to examine several families in which the name Anfilog could independently have turned into a patronymic and then into a stable family naming.
strings.Найти служебные продолжения рязанских но: Find service continuations of the Ryazan bearers of the name between the 1530s and the founding of Oryol.
strings.Вернуться к Лодыгиным только при появлен: Return to the Lodygins only if a patronymic, inherited land or a direct formula of transfer between the Kashin circle and southern service appears.
strings.Искать семерых орловских отцов по полным: Search for the seven Oryol fathers by full formulas and former pomestyes, without assuming a common surname in advance.
strings.Заказать однолистные акты Архива СПбИИ Р: Order the single-sheet acts of the Archive of the St Petersburg Institute of History of the Russian Academy of Sciences (SPbII РАН), f. 5, op. 1, d. 554 and 567: check the boundaries of the Anfilovskaya village and the full formulary of Anfilofy Novik's deed of purchase.
strings.Не объединять региональные случаи без пр: Do not merge regional cases without a direct kinship or migration formula.
strings.Около 1495—1497 годов Анфилоф Селиванов: Around 1495–1497 Anfilof Selivanov was one of six men present at the court of the Yaroslavl tiun Afanasy Durov in the dispute over the Krestsy hayfield on the Kotorosl. He is the direct and earliest personal bearer found of the rare form Anfilof in the relevant generation. A geographical link with Onfilogovo in Tver has not been established.
strings.Около 1495—1497 годов судья — ярославски: Around 1495–1497 the judge — the Yaroslavl tiun Afanasy Durov — heard the dispute of the Spaso-Yaroslavsky Monastery with Mikitka Levonov over the Krestsy hayfield on the Kotorosl river. After the decision in favour of the monastery, the act lists six men who were present at the court; the last named is Anfilof Selivanov. The formula proves the existence of a real layman with a rare name in the generation suitable for the emergence of the name Onfilogovo. It does not call him a peasant, owner, or founder and does not connect him with Tver uyezd.
strings.Не установлены социальное положение, отч: Anfilof Selivanov's social status, patronymic, age, and holdings have not been established.
strings.Не найдена связь с Тверским уездом, Юрло: No link with Tver uyezd, the Yurlovs, or Nikolskoye Svechino has been found.
